name: Inland Wetlands Conservation Program
summary: California state funding for protecting, restoring and enhancing wetlands and associated habitat on the Central Valley floor, in support of the Central Valley Joint Venture's bird population goals.

status.quote: WCB is now accepting pre-applications through the new WCB Project Portal.

access.quote: WCB is now accepting pre-applications through the new WCB Project Portal.

geography.quote: focus on the Central Valley floor, which extends approximately 400 miles from Red Bluff in the north to Bakersfield in the south

applicant_types.quote: Unless otherwise limited by applicable funding sources or individual program guidelines, WCB has the authority under FGC section 1350(c) to award grants to 501(c)(3) nonprofit organizations, local governmental agencies, federal agencies, state agencies, and California Native American tribes.
